summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(), gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title) for legacy consoles. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md has a new Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Nothing was run or committed; verification was by reading only, so tests and mypy have not been executed.
